admission.justification: Configured native dashboard watcher generations. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

conditions: Discovery, refresher and native-child failure share reported outage and retry.
downSince is omitted while healthy; no watcher configuration omits the whole health field.
exclusions: No recursive polling compatibility path is introduced.
statement: Watcher root-discovery and root-worker failure enter the same stable reported outage and thirty-second retry, and healthy payloads omit downSince.
